item.title: Copilot vs Cursor vs Codeium vs Windsurf: AI Coding Assistant Comparison (2026)
item.description:
AI coding assistants have become an essential part of every developer’s workflow. This comparison covers the four major players as of 2026.

Quick Comparison Table

Feature GitHub Copilot Cursor Codeium / Windsurf Amazon Q Developer
Pricing $10/mo (Individual) $20/mo (Pro) $15/mo (Pro) Free (Individual)
Free Tier ✅ 30-day trial ✅ Limited ✅ Generous free ✅ Full free
IDE Support VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim Built-in editor (VS Code fork) VS Code, JetBrains VS Code, JetBrains
Chat ✅ Yes ✅ Yes ✅ Yes ✅ Yes
Agent Mode ✅ (Preview) ✅ Yes ✅ Yes ❌
Context Length 8K tokens 20K tokens 16K tokens 4K tokens
GitHub Stars N/A 35K+ 30K+ N/A
Best For Enterprise teams Power users Cost-conscious teams Budget-friendly

Detailed Analysis

GitHub Copilot

Pros:

  • Tightest integration with GitHub ecosystem
  • Enterprise-grade security and compliance
  • Copilot Chat understands your entire repo context

Cons:

  • Higher latency than competitors
  • Limited context window (8K tokens)
  • Agent mode still in preview

Best for: Teams already using GitHub Enterprise, or developers wanting the most battle-tested solution.

Cursor

Pros:

  • Best-in-class agent mode that writes and runs code autonomously
  • Largest context window (20K tokens)
  • Fastest inference speed
  • Built-in Composer for multi-file edits

Cons:

  • Requires using Cursor’s custom editor (VS Code fork)
  • No JetBrains support
  • Higher price ($20/mo)

Best for: Developers who want AI to actively execute and test code, not just suggest it.

Codeium / Windsurf

Pros:

  • Generous free tier
  • Multi-IDE support (VS Code + JetBrains)
  • Good context understanding (16K tokens)
  • Cascade mode for multi-step tasks

Cons:

  • Less accurate on complex codebases
  • Slower updates than Cursor
  • Smaller community/plugins

Best for: Budget-conscious developers who still want good AI assistance.

Amazon Q Developer

Pros:

  • Completely free for individual use
  • Good for AWS ecosystem projects
  • Security scanning built-in

Cons:

  • Smallest context window (4K tokens)
  • Limited agent capabilities
  • AWS-centric bias

Best for: AWS-heavy projects, or developers wanting a free AI assistant.

Performance Benchmarks

Based on community testing and published benchmarks:

Metric Copilot Cursor Codeium Amazon Q
Acceptance Rate 35% 42% 38% 28%
Latency (avg) 800ms 450ms 600ms 900ms
Accuracy (Python) 4.2/5 4.5/5 3.8/5 3.5/5
Accuracy (TypeScript) 4.0/5 4.3/5 3.7/5 3.3/5
Accuracy (Go) 3.8/5 4.1/5 3.5/5 3.0/5

Pricing Comparison (as of May 2026)

Plan Copilot Cursor Codeium Amazon Q
Free ❌ (30-day trial) Limited ✅ Generous ✅ Full
Individual $10/mo $20/mo $15/mo Free
Business $19/user/mo $40/user/mo $25/user/mo N/A
Enterprise $39/user/mo Custom Custom N/A

Verdict

Choose based on your priority:

  • 🏆 Best overall: Cursor — fastest, most capable agent mode, largest context
  • 💰 Best value: Copilot — solid performance at lower price with ecosystem integration
  • 🆓 Best free tier: Codeium/Windsurf — generous free offering
  • 🔐 Best for enterprise: Copilot — compliance and security features
  • 💵 Best budget option: Amazon Q Developer — completely free
